    People also ask
    Is LaGuardia or JFK closer to NYC?
    An AI Overview is not available for this searchCan't generate an AI overview right now. Try again later.
    AI Overview
    LaGuardia Airport (LGA)
     is significantly closer to New York City (specifically Manhattan) than     JFK Airport. LGA is located about 8 miles from Midtown Manhattan, making it the most convenient choice for faster travel times during non-peak traffic, while JFK is further out at roughly 15-16 miles. 
    • LGA (LaGuardia): Closest to Manhattan and the best option for quick access to the city, especially for domestic flights.
    • JFK: Farther away, but primarily handles international flights and has better direct public transit links to the city.
    • Time Difference: A taxi/rideshare to Manhattan from LGA typically takes around 20–30 minutes, whereas from JFK it often takes 45–60+ minutes depending on traffic.
